TI.P: Corrigendum to the Commission communication concerning the prolongation of the Community guidelines on State aid for rescuing and restructuring firms in difficulty
(Official Journal of the European Union C 157 of 10 July 2009)

CORRECTION.DESCRIPTION: The text of the Commission communication published in the Official Journal of the European Union C 157 of 10 July 2009, p. 1, should be considered as null and void since an identical text has already been published in the Official Journal of the European Union C 156 of 9 July 2009, p. 3.
